## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `TurboDL-Setup-0.7.1.exe` | Windows 10/11 (x64) |
| `TurboDL-0.7.1-arm64.dmg` | macOS on Apple Silicon (M1 and newer) |
| `TurboDL-0.7.1-x64.dmg` | macOS on Intel |
| `TurboDL-Firefox-0.7.1.xpi` | the Firefox add-on |

## What's new

- **Signing in during a signed-out backup.** Say you back up a profile seen signed out and sign in to Instagram while it runs. Once the backup ends, the profile reopens with your session the next time you open it. Before, it stayed on the signed-out page, so the next backup or **Continue** took the slower signed-out way, and the banner still said "Seen signed out".

Everything else is as in 0.7.0 (Instagram profiles and highlights without signing in).

## Updating

- Install the new version over the old one and open TurboDL once.
- The browser extension has not changed; there is nothing to reload.
- Firefox: open `TurboDL-Firefox-0.7.1.xpi` in Firefox. Regular Firefox only installs add-ons signed by Mozilla; if this file is unsigned, use Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR with `xpinstall.signatures.required` set to `false`.

The Windows installer is not signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
